# Vishnu Balaji Global Imports & Exports

> Vishnu Balaji Global Imports & Exports is an APEDA-registered and DGFT-licensed Indian agricultural commodity trading and export enterprise. The company specializes in direct farm-gate procurement and bulk containerized export of premium 1121 Basmati Rice, Non-Basmati Rice, Milling Wheat, Pigeon Pea (Toor Dal), Pure Turmeric, Dry Red Chilli, Maharashtra Onions, Millets, and Fresh Tender Coconuts to international distributors, supermarket chains, and food manufacturers across GCC/Middle East, Europe, Southeast Asia, Africa, and North America.

- **Primary Origin Ports**: Mundra Port (Gujarat - INMUN1), JNPT / Nhava Sheva (Maharashtra - INNSA1), Chennai Port (Tamil Nadu - INMAA1), Kakinada Port (Andhra Pradesh - INKAK1)
- **Pre-Shipment Quality Inspections**: SGS, Intertek, Cotecna, Bureau Veritas (weight, quality, moisture, phytosanitary verification)

## Core Export Commodities & Specifications

- [1121 Basmati Rice](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/products/1121-basmati-rice.html): Extra-long grain (8.35mm+ uncooked length), Steam, Golden Sella, White Sella, and Raw varieties sourced from Punjab and Haryana belts. Moisture < 12.5%, sortex cleaned 100%, elongation ratio 2.5x. MOQ: 1x20ft FCL (24-26 MT).
- [Non-Basmati Rice](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/products/non-basmati-rice.html): PR-11, IR-64, Sona Masoori, Parboiled and White Milled rice. 5% to 25% broken options. Sourced from Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Chhattisgarh.
- [Milling & Durum Wheat](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/products/wheat.html): High-protein milling wheat (11.5% to 13.5% protein), Sharbati and Lokwan varieties sourced from Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra. Moisture < 12%, foreign matter < 1%.
- [Pigeon Pea / Toor Dal](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/products/pigeon-pea.html): Premium machine-cleaned and unpolished/polished Yellow Pigeon Pea sourced from Gulbarga (Karnataka) and Latur (Maharashtra). Purity 99.5%, moisture < 10%.
- [Pure Turmeric](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/products/turmeric.html): Nizamabad and Salem origin finger and bulb turmeric. High natural curcumin content (3% to 5%+), moisture < 10%, zero artificial polish. Available in whole fingers and ground powder.
- [Dry Red Chilli](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/products/dry-red-chilli.html): S4 Sanam (334), Teja (S17), and Byadgi varieties sourced from Guntur (Andhra Pradesh) and Warangal (Telangana). Available with stem and stemless. Heat levels from 15,000 to 75,000 SHU.
- [Maharashtra Fresh Onions](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/products/maharashtra-onions.html): Nashik origin red onions (45mm+ to 55mm+ diameter). High pungency and dry matter for extended maritime transit. Packed in 5kg, 10kg, 25kg, and 50kg ventilated mesh bags.
- [Sorghum & Millets](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/products/sorghum-millets.html): Pearl Millet (Bajra), Finger Millet (Ragi), and Yellow/White Sorghum (Jowar). Non-GMO, gluten-free grains for human consumption and feed.
- [Fresh Green Tender Coconuts](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/products/green-tender-coconuts.html): Pollachi and Godavari river basin coconuts containing 350ml-500ml+ electrolyte water. Diamond-cut or natural husk for refrigerated reefer container shipments.

## Authoritative Trade Documentation & Importer Guides

- [How to Import Basmati Rice from India Guide](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/guides/how-to-import-basmati-rice-from-india.html): Step-by-step procurement, APEDA export policies, MEP thresholds, and customs clearance procedures.
- [Agricultural Export Documentation SOP](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/guides/agricultural-export-documentation-sop.html): Comprehensive breakdown of Bill of Lading, Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary Certificate, Fumigation Certificate, and SGS Inspection protocols.
- [FOB vs CIF Incoterms for Agricultural Importers](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/guides/fob-vs-cif-incoterms-agricultural-export.html): Risk transfer matrix, ocean freight handling, demurrage prevention, and insurance allocation.
- [International Export Markets Buying Guide](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/guides/international-export-markets-buying-guide.html): Compliance specifications for GCC (SASO, ESMA), EU (MRL pesticide limits), and Southeast Asian import standards.


## Priority Trade Corridors & Destination Hubs
- [UAE & Dubai Export Hub](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/destinations/dubai-uae-agricultural-exports.html): Direct maritime corridor to Jebel Ali Port (3–5 days transit). Specializing in 1121 Sella Basmati, Spices, and Onions.
- [Saudi Arabia Export Hub](https://www.vishnubalajiglobal.com/destinations/saudi-arabia-agricultural-exports.html): SFDA and SASO compliant shipments to King Abdulaziz Port (Dammam) and Jeddah Islamic Port.
